problem: Home health agencies ran on fragmented operations, so the company set out to give distributed care networks software, hardware and operating support.
business_model: Software, hardware and operating services sold to home health agencies (model not detailed in sources)
product_category: Home health agency software and hardware

founders.name: Jennifer Ma
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists her with no bio.

founders.name: Ryan Martin
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists him with no bio.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining software, hardware and operations for distributed care networks is multi-disciplinary, but the sources describe no product details.

defensibility.rationale: No sources show customers, data or integrations, so no moat can be cited.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source describes any incumbent action against the company.

market_need_then: No source gives demand evidence for this company specifically. Home health agency software vendors such as AlayaCare were already selling cloud platforms by 2015.

branding.domain_note: Uses anchorhealth.com; no source on acquisition.

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated home care providers share the name Anchor Health, and no press about the brand exists.

outcome_analysis: The cause of the company's inactivity is not public. Searches found no shutdown notice, acquisition or press coverage, only directories that label it inactive, so failure factors stay empty. The record shows a two person YC team with no disclosed funding and no traceable traction.
notes: The company website safety check was rate limited, so the site was not fetched. A third-party directory estimates about $125K total funding, unverified and not recorded as a round. StartupIntros lists a $2M seed for a company called Anchor in 2016-02 with angel Brendan Iribe, but that page does not establish it is this company, so it is not recorded. Competitor search found no dated 2016 competitors tied to this company. Name confusion with Ankr Health (W22) and many unrelated home care providers.
